crossRefs.note: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple…
Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for…
For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.
The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called…
They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?
They were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and…
They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said…
For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works…

people.name: Beautiful_Gate
people.line: Gate of the Jerusalem temple, site of Peter's miracle.

translations.web: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
translations.bsb: they recognized him as the man who used to sit begging at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
translations.kjv: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
translations.asv: and they took knowledge of him, that it was he that sat for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
